AddHkInstrumentsResponse.title: AddHkInstrumentsResponse

BacktestLimitsBody.title: BacktestLimitsBody
BacktestLimitsBody.description: The request and the response of the backtest limits routes.

BacktestMetricsResponse.title: BacktestMetricsResponse

The metrics of docs/architecture/backtest.md section 10.9.2. A metric without a meaning is null, and
`missing_reasons` gives its reason by its field name (section 10.9.3). The page shows "–" with the reason.

out_of_sample_to_in_sample_sharpe_percen.title: Out Of Sample To In Sample Sharpe Percent

BacktestRobustnessResponse.title: BacktestRobustnessResponse
BacktestRobustnessResponse.description:
The robustness checks of docs/architecture/backtest.md sections 10.9.4 and 10.9.5, calculated at each read. A
value without a meaning is null. `missing_reasons` gives the reason of a null `sharpe_probability_percent`.

BarPeriod.description: The bar periods that the chart offers. The values use the NautilusTrader bar specification format.
BarPeriod.title: BarPeriod

BarResponse.title: BarResponse

BarSource.title: BarSource

ComparedInterruptionResponse.title: ComparedInterruptionResponse
ComparedInterruptionResponse.description: A time without a running LiveNode (section 12.7). The chart marks it grey.

ComparedMetricsResponse.title: ComparedMetricsResponse
ComparedMetricsResponse.description:
The metrics of `GET /api/backtests/{id}` (docs/architecture/backtest.md section 10.9.2) and the Net profit: the
final equity minus the start capital. A forward test has no split metrics and no robustness (section 12.10).

ForwardTestCapitalResponse.title: ForwardTestCapitalResponse
ForwardTestCapitalResponse.description:
The capital of the paper account in USD (section 12.18). All 3 are None when the paper account check did not
pass or IBKR has no NetLiquidation value in USD.

ForwardTestDetailResponse.title: ForwardTestDetailResponse
ForwardTestDetailResponse.description:
The forward test page: the forward test, its records, and the backtests that "Backtest the same period" started,
newest first.

IndicatorOperand.title: IndicatorOperand
IndicatorOperand.description: A stored indicator reference. A single-line indicator without `output` uses `value`.

InnerRuleGroup.title: InnerRuleGroup
InnerRuleGroup.description: A group in a group. It holds conditions only, so the maximum depth is 1 nested group.

ManualOrderWithFillsResponse.title: ManualOrderWithFillsResponse
ManualOrderWithFillsResponse.description: A stored order by hand with its fills from reqExecutions. None when ATrade cannot ask IBKR.

OrderRefusedByLedgerResponse.title: OrderRefusedByLedgerResponse
OrderRefusedByLedgerResponse.description: An order rule of the owner ledger failed for "By hand". ATrade did not send the order (section 11.10).

OrderRefusedResponse.title: OrderRefusedResponse
OrderRefusedResponse.description: The paper account check did not pass. ATrade did not send the order.

PaperCapitalResponse.title: PaperCapitalResponse
PaperCapitalResponse.description: The default paper capital of the backtest form (docs/architecture.md section 10).

PercentOfEquity.title: PercentOfEquity
PercentOfEquity.description: The quantity is equity x percent / close price, rounded down to whole shares.

RuleExits.title: RuleExits
RuleExits.description: The exit items. Each item that is not null (or `true`) is selected.

SavedBarsResponse.title: SavedBarsResponse
SavedBarsResponse.description: The saved bars of one bar source and one bar period: the start of the first and of the last saved bar.

SourceOrderBody.description: The global source order: the first bar source that saved a time range gives all bars of the range.

StartBacktestRequest.description:
`universe_kind` `single` (the default) needs `symbol`, `exchange`, and `currency`, `rule` needs `top_n`, and
`list` needs `instruments` or `screen_result_id` (docs/architecture/backtest.md section 10.10.6).

AbortMessage.title: AbortMessage

AssistantErrorMessage.description: An error of the conversation, for the Output tab of the "Problems and output" panel.
AssistantErrorMessage.title: AssistantErrorMessage

BacktestFinishedMessage.description: A backtest of `run_backtest` ended in the wait of the tool, for the metric card.
BacktestFinishedMessage.title: BacktestFinishedMessage

LiveBarMessage.description: The current bar. A bar with the time of the last bar replaces it; a later time adds a bar.
LiveBarMessage.title: LiveBarMessage

LoginAnswerMessage.description: Browser to server: the answer to a login step `prompt`. For a `select` prompt, the ID of the option.
LoginAnswerMessage.title: LoginAnswerMessage

LoginEndMessage.description: The login ended. The credential is in the credential file of the assistant service.
LoginEndMessage.title: LoginEndMessage

LoginStartMessage.description: Browser to server: start a login. `method` "oauth" is a subscription login. `name` names the new credential.
LoginStartMessage.title: LoginStartMessage

LoginStepMessage.description:
One login step of pi (25.7.3).

- `auth_url`: open `url` (the authorization link). `message` has the instructions of the provider.
- `device_code`: enter `user_code` at `url`.
- `progress`, `info`: `message` (and for `info` maybe a `url`).
- `prompt`: show a field for `prompt_type` (`text`, `secret` as a password field, `select` with `options`, or
  `manual_code` to paste a code) with the label `message`, and answer with `login_answer` and `prompt_id`.
LoginStepMessage.title: LoginStepMessage

MessageDeltaMessage.description: A part of the streamed text of an AI assistant message.
MessageDeltaMessage.title: MessageDeltaMessage

MessageEndMessage.description: The end of one AI assistant message: its full text, its model, and its credential name.
MessageEndMessage.title: MessageEndMessage

OwnerPositionMessage.description: The part of an IBKR position that belongs to one owner in the owner ledger (section 11.10).
OwnerPositionMessage.title: OwnerPositionMessage

PaperAccountBalanceMessage.description: The balance in USD. The base currency values and the rate show what ATrade converted (section 11.9).
PaperAccountBalanceMessage.title: PaperAccountBalanceMessage

PromptMessage.description: Browser to server: a new user message, with the provider, the model, and the credential of this message.
PromptMessage.title: PromptMessage

RunStateMessage.description: The state of the run of the conversation: `running` from the prompt, `settled` after the end of the run.
RunStateMessage.title: RunStateMessage

SteerMessage.description: Browser to server: a user message while the AI assistant runs.
SteerMessage.title: SteerMessage

StrategyVersionSavedMessage.description: The AI assistant saved a strategy version, for the diff card (25.5.2).
StrategyVersionSavedMessage.title: StrategyVersionSavedMessage

ToolStepMessage.description:
The start, an update, or the end of one tool call. One `tool_call_id` is one tool step of the conversation.

`status` is `running` at the start and at each update, then `succeeded` or `failed`. For `run_backtest`,
`backtest_id` and `backtest_status` give the queue state (`queued`) or the run state (`running`, then a final
status). They are null for the other tools and at the start.
ToolStepMessage.title: ToolStepMessage
